levels.name: Rock, the Backbone of Earth
levels.description: Increases the maximum number of Stone Steles created by Dominus Lapidis that may exist simultaneously to 2.

levels.name: Stone, the Cradle of Jade
levels.description: Planet Befall grants nearby characters on the field a Jade Shield when it descends.

levels.name: Jade, Shimmering through Darkness
levels.description: Increases the Level of Dominus Lapidis by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Topaz, Unbreakable and Fearless
levels.description: Increases Planet Befall's AoE by 20% and increases the duration of Planet Befall's Petrification effect by 2s.

levels.name: Lazuli, Herald of the Order
levels.description: Increases the Level of Planet Befall by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Chrysos, Bounty of Dominator
levels.description: When the Jade Shield takes DMG, 40% of that incoming DMG is converted to HP for the current character. A single instance of regeneration cannot exceed 8% of that character's Max HP
